# study.exe - LLM Context File
# https://studyexe.com

## About
study.exe (studyexe.com) is a Windows desktop productivity application designed for students who are serious about studying. It uses eye-tracking technology to enforce focus during study sessions.

## Product Summary
- **Name**: study.exe (StudyForge)
- **Platform**: Windows 10/11 Desktop Application
- **Category**: Education, Productivity, Focus Tools
- **Target Audience**: Students, learners, anyone who wants to stay focused

## Key Features
1. **Eye-Tracking Focus Detection** - Uses webcam to detect when you look away
2. **Active Recall Sessions** - Read, then write what you remember from memory
3. **AI-Powered Scoring** - Get feedback on your recall accuracy using GPT
4. **Spaced Repetition Flashcards** - SM-2 algorithm for optimal retention
5. **MCQ Practice Mode** - Test yourself with multiple choice questions
6. **PDF & Text Document Support** - Study any material
7. **Focus Analytics Dashboard** - Track your study performance over time
8. **Streak Tracking** - Gamified motivation system

## Philosophy
"Study. Or Die Trying." - The app is designed for students who are tired of half-measures and want a tool that holds them accountable. No sugarcoating, no participation trophies.

## Technical Details
- Built with Python, PyQt6
- Eye tracking via MediaPipe
- Local SQLite database (privacy-first)
- AI scoring via OpenAI API (optional)
